rule.name: DestroyLeavesDescendants
rule.message: This destroys a process that the method started through a shell, a launcher or a script (sh, cmd, npm, npx, yarn, pnpm, gradlew.bat, mvnw.cmd, a .sh, .bat or .cmd file), after a wait with a deadline. destroy() and destroyForcibly() stop only that process; the real work runs in a child of it and keeps running, holding CPU, memory, files and ports, and may still write into a folder the caller is deleting. Destroy the descendants first: process.descendants().forEach(ProcessHandle::destroyForcibly), then the process itself, or start the executable directly without the wrapper.
